summary: Recent updates to the OpenGL context management in Firefox have introduced support for **high-power graphics contexts** through the new CreateContextFlags::HIGH_POWER option for EGL/ANGLE, which is a layer that allows WebGL content to interact with native graphics systems. This enhancement is crucial for applications that demand additional graphical performance, such as video games or 3D modeling tools, ensuring a smoother user experience on capable hardware. Additionally, the refactoring of the GLLibraryEGL::CreateDisplay() function into a flags structure simplifies the way options are managed, improving code maintainability and paving the way for future enhancements. _Overall, while users may not see an immediate visual change, these advancements set the groundwork for more powerful graphics capabilities in web applications._
